name: Bahia Principe Explore Coba

kids_club.evidence: Bahia Scouts is included for ages 4-12 and groups children by age (3-7s together). Recent reviews praise the staff, the water-park sessions and the kids' evening shows. Hours are not published (about 9am-5pm per traveller reports from the complex), so it falls short of a 5.

water_play.evidence: Coba has its own kids' water park with slides, waterfalls, splash zones and a shallow pool. One family blogger thought it suited ages 3-6 best.

beach.evidence: Coba is set back from the sea. A shuttle (about every 10-15 min) or a walk gets you to a small beach area beside Tulum's stretch, which is eroding and has seaweed in season. Some reviewers found the water shallow and safe; others found the beach far and small.

rooms.evidence: All rooms are junior suites with 2 double beds (or a king) plus a sofa bed and sleep 4. 'PLAY' family versions are offered, and family suites can be joined. Reviewers find them spacious but dated.

food.evidence: Kukulcan buffet gets good reviews for variety and desserts. Three à la carte restaurants (Le Gourmet, Mikado, Portofino), plus exchange dinners at Tulum and Akumal, are capped at 3 bookings per week, booked in the app up to 10 days ahead. Mikado's teppanyaki and the buffet add variety.

transfer.evidence: 96 km from CUN; Oyster says just over an hour and transfer firms quote 80-90 min. TQO is about 63 km and roughly an hour away but has fewer international nonstops than CUN.

condition.evidence: No renovation has been announced for Coba; 2026 reviewers call the rooms clean but dated. Akumal's renovation (to Nov 30, 2026) is in the same complex but a separate building area.

kids_club.name: Bahia Scouts + Teens Club
kids_club.hours: not published; about 9am-5pm per traveller reports (unverified)
kids_club.notes: The water park is next to the club. Hacienda Doña Isabel (shared) hosts kids' carnival nights. Babysitting is extra, from age 2.

pros: Water park with kids' slides and a shallow splash pool on site
Every room is a suite with 2 double beds plus a sofa bed
Buffet is well reviewed for variety
Shuttle trains to Tulum and Akumal restaurants, the beach and the Hacienda
cons: Not on the beach: shuttle to a small beach area
Shares the Tulum stretch of beach, which is eroding and gets heavy seaweed in spring
Rooms dated and no renovation announced
Only 3 à la carte dinners a week
verdict: Coba has the best on-site water park in the complex at a lower tier, but families would trade a real beachfront and fresh rooms for it.
